summary: Discover screen iteration verified end-to-end. 15/15 backend pytest tests passed: GET /api/events with tab=overview|joined|past|mine and event_type filter combos all return the expected event ids (overview→e1-e5, joined→e8, past→e6,e7,e8, mine→e6,e7, cultural→e3,e7, overview+activity→e4). Regression on /api/me, /api/spots, /api/chats, /api/chats/{id}/messages PASS. No 'post is not defined' or orphan-route errors at startup — backend boots cleanly. Frontend (390x844 mobile): Stories section REMOVED (no 'Your Story' / story rings). Title 'Events' renders. Search input visible with correct placeholder. 4 tabs Overview/Joined/Past/My events render with underline indicator under active tab; each tab swaps the visible cards (Overview 5, Joined 1, Past 3, Mine 2) — counts match seed. Filter sliders button to the right of tabs opens a bottom sheet titled 'Filter by type' with 7 rows (All types, Cultural, Activity, Informal, Professional, Creative, Health), each with colored icon. Selecting Cultural + Show events returns only the matching cultural events for the active tab (Overview→Jazz only because Vinyl is past; switching to Past→Vinyl). Active type chip 'Type: Cultural' shows with × clear button that resets to all. Search filters cards (jazz→Rooftop Jazz Night). Cards match new compact list style: square thumbnail left, bold title, calendar+date row, map-pin+city·Xkm row, host avatar+first-name, capacity badge (X/Y or 'Open'), type icon in top-right corner. Tapping a card navigates to /event/[id] detail page successfully. FloatingTabBar tabs (Map/Chats/Profile) all navigate. Center Create FAB opens /create modal with 3 options (Create Event / Add a Spot / Post a Story).

minor.issue: Spec says overview should exclude both past events AND events where host_id=='me', but the backend only filters by date (line 427-428 in server.py). Today this works because seeded e6 (2026-03-04) happens to be past relative to system clock (May 21, 2026), so it is excluded by the date filter. However if a future event with host_id='me' is created via POST /api/events, it WILL appear in Overview — diverging from the spec. Recommend: add `and e.host_id != 'me'` to the overview branch.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated for future RN/web compatibility.

action_items: Optional backend tightening: in /api/events overview branch, also exclude events where host_id == 'me' so the rule holds for future events authored by 'me' (currently only date filter is applied).

Optional code cleanup: server.py duplicates `app.include_router(api_router)` and `app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware,...)` blocks (lines 540-548 are repeated again at 554-565). Functionally harmless (idempotent) but should be deduped.
Optional web-compat: replace deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents props with boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: 'overview' tab only filters by date >= now and does NOT exclude host_id=='me'. Seed data coincidentally makes the visible result correct, but the rule is incomplete per spec.
server.py: include_router + add_middleware are registered twice. Should be cleaned up.
discover.tsx: query-string trimming logic in api.events drops 'all' values correctly; tab change triggers reload via useEffect dependency — good.

EventListCard.tsx + TypeFilterSheet.tsx: All required testIDs present (event-card-{id}, open-type-filter, type-{key}, filter-apply, clear-type-filter, tab-{key}). Card composition matches reference design (thumbnail/title/type icon/date/location/host/capacity).
Backend in-memory mutates module state; acceptable for MVP demo but events list grows across server restarts unless reset.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of spec'd flows (stories removed, 4 tabs working, filter sheet working, type chip + clear, search, new card style, card→detail nav, other tabs + create FAB)

seed_data_creation: None — all assertions use existing seeded events e1-e8.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://glass-discovery-1.preview.emergentagent.com. System clock is May 21 2026 UTC, so seeded events e6 (Mar 4 2026), e7 (Dec 2025), e8 (Nov 2025) are all in the past; e1-e5 are in June 2026 and the only future events. Discover tab default is 'overview'. Filter sheet testIDs: open-type-filter, type-{all|cultural|activity|informal|professional|creative|health}, filter-apply, clear-type-filter. Card testID: event-card-{id}. Tab keys (discover screen): tab-overview, tab-joined, tab-past, tab-mine. Bottom bar keys (FloatingTabBar): tab-map, tab-discover, tab-chats, tab-profile, tab-create. Backend is in-memory — POST /events / POST going / POST messages mutate module globals.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bug. Only an over-permissive overview filter (date-only) that is masked by current seed/clock. Mitigation noted in action items.
